message_analysis: Crystal clear single message: Google launches AI products for headlines, then buries them quietly when they fail to compete—and users should be wary. Every scene reinforces this: the silent kill (shock), the pattern (revelation), the mechanism (why), the consequence (personal stakes), and the loop (remember next time). The angle is original—framing corporate product death as a scandal of *silence* rather than failure itself. The hook promises insider knowledge of a cover-up and delivers exactly that. This would resonate because it taps institutional distrust + personal vulnerability (your tools could vanish).
scroll_stop_analysis: The first 1.5 seconds are lethal: black screen, white text slamming in, Google logo glitching out mid-frame, caption 'GOOGLE DELETED THIS… AND SAID NOTHING.' This creates immediate curiosity (What was deleted?) + shock (No announcement?). Pattern interrupts are strong: kinetic text, screen recordings, rapid-fire montage, talking-head, calendar animation, logo replay. Pacing is tight—no scene exceeds 6s, no dead air. Emotion arc builds: shock → intrigue → revelation → urgency (repeated). The loop callback to Scene 1's glitch is native TikTok (symmetry + rewatchability). Feels like insider tech commentary, not a lecture. Would stop a scroller.
